deleteSelectedFiles.description: Button text for deleting multiple selected files.

alertNoFilesSelected.description: Alert when the delete button is clicked with no files checked.

contextMenuTitle.description: Title for the right-click context menu item.

confirmDelete.message: Вы уверены, что хотите удалить $COUNT$ файл(ов)?
confirmDelete.description: Confirmation prompt before deleting files. $COUNT$ is a placeholder for the number of files.

deleting.description: Text shown on the delete button while files are being deleted.

alertPleaseSelectFile.description: Alert when the upload form is submitted with no file chosen.

confirmRename.message:
Имя файла содержит пробелы и будет переименовано в:

$FILENAME$

Продолжить?
confirmRename.description: Confirmation prompt when a filename is being sanitized. $FILENAME$ is a placeholder for the new name.

uploading.description: Text shown on the upload button during an upload.

alertUploadSuccess.description: Alert shown after a successful file upload.

alertUploadFailed.message: Ошибка загрузки. Сервер ответил со статусом: $STATUS$
alertUploadFailed.description: Alert shown when an upload fails due to a server error. $STATUS$ is a placeholder for the HTTP status.

alertUploadError.description: Alert shown when an upload fails due to a network or other error. $MESSAGE$ is a placeholder for the error message.

alertZipTooLarge.message: Слишком много данных для одного zip (макс. 4 ГБ). Выберите меньше файлов или папку поменьше.
